title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.1 mixture-of-experts model
summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.1, a mixture-of-experts model trained at approximately 6 percent of the pre-training cost of comparable frontier models. It surpasses DeepSeek V4 Pro on benchmarks including τ³-bench and SpreadsheetBench-Verified and approaches Gemini 3.1 Pro on reasoning.

web_findings.title: ERNIE 5.1 Officially Released
web_findings.snippet: Released 9 May 2026; ranks 4th on Arena Search globally, 1st among Chinese models with score 1,223.

web_findings.title: Baidu's Ernie 5.1 cuts 94 percent of pre-training costs
web_findings.snippet: Text-only MoE with roughly half the active parameters per forward pass of ERNIE 5.0.

web_findings.title: Baidu Unveils ERNIE 5.0, New AI Chips
